title: The Faithful Clock
author: Xanthe Eriksen
blurb: Mirabel Ravensworth, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
